title: The V3 kill-switch checkpoint cases hedge every assertion behind "if the log fired", so a V3 buy path where pause never stops the buy, or where CP3 never records the trade, passes; only the V2 cases actually prove the kill switch

evidence.note: V3 CP1: "if (cp1) expect(feeTier)"; the only unconditional assertion is sendTxWithRetry not called, which also holds if the handler returned before CP1 for any reason
V3 CP2: conditional feeTier check; the comment says quoteExactInputSingle "was called" but nothing asserts it
V3 CP3: every assertion, including "insertTrade STILL called", is inside if (cp3): zero assertions run when CP3 is not reached
V3 happy path asserts only that no killswitch log fired; it never asserts the buy was sent
contrast: the V2 CP3 case asserts the log, sendTxWithRetry, insertTrade and startExitMonitor unconditionally

sibling_sites_checked: All eight cases of the file and pauseFlow Test 9 (V2 CP1 only); v3HoneypotIntegration Test 4 shows the V3 buy path can reach sendTxWithRetry with equivalent mocks, so the hedging is not forced by the harness. No fork test exercises pause on a V3 buy.
severity_rationale: S2: the kill switch is a capital control (pause must stop new buys); four V3 cases are hollow, so a V3 regression would buy while paused with the suite green.
recommendation: Phase 28: make the V3 cases assert unconditionally that the handler reached the checkpoint (the killswitch log with feeTier), that the quoter was called for CP2, and that CP3 records the trade; make the V3 happy path assert the buy was sent.
affected_cases: paused=1 → pino info { op: killswitch.cp1, feeTier } + sendTxWithRetry NEVER called
paused flips between CP1 and CP2 on V3 path → pino info { op: killswitch.cp2, feeTier } + V3 quoteExactInputSingle WAS called
paused=1 ONLY at V3 CP3 (post-submit) → pino info { op: killswitch.cp3, feeTier } + insertTrade STILL called
paused=0 throughout → no killswitch.* log fires on V3 path
escaped_regression: Delete the CP2 pause read from handleNewV3PoolForChain: a V3 pool found just before a pause is still bought after the pause, and the V3 CP2 case stays green (its feeTier check is skipped and sendTxWithRetry not being called is not asserted against a reached CP2).
